title: Non-Coding RNA Dysregulation in Autism Spectrum Disorder: Mechanisms, Biomarkers, and Therapeutic Perspectives.
abstract: Review of ncRNA dysregulation (miRNA, lncRNA, circRNA, piRNA) in ASD, competing endogenous RNA networks regulating SHANK3, SYNGAP1, CHD8 and NMDAR signaling; proposes ncRNAs as candidate biomarkers pending replication.
